CIRCUIT OPERATIONLE
The NOT gate is represented by a triangle symbol with a circle. The circle is commonly called a bubble.
DISCUSSION
A NOT gate has one input and one output.
The function of a NOT gate is to invert the input signal...
The NOT gate can be an independent gate used to invert a signal.
The NOT gate can also be part of the input or output to another gate.
This circuit demonstrates the function of a NOT gate. The switch represents the input to the NOT gate and the light bulb represents the output.
If the input is high (switch closed) there is a low output from the NOT gate (lamp). In this case current is taking the path of least resistance to the battery's negative terminal.
When the switch is OFF, input is low, the output from the NOT gate is high. In this case there is only one path for current, through the lamp.lamp.
When the input is HIGH or TRUE the NOT gate produces a LOW or FALSE output.
When the input is LOW the NOT gate produces a HIGH output..
